pixel_oracle: Full uncropped mask + same three-pass convolution at DPR 1/1.5/2, blur 0/2/5, inline/host, fractional offsets, clips and overrides. Plain glyphs require exact QImage equality; outlined paths allow one premultiplied component unit for translated Qt rasterization. Cache hits remain exactly equal. A separate right-aligned host fixture requires exact full-canvas equality.
